set.body: PRD DOC-R8. Map each eyesim entry point to the corresponding public eyes4s task workflow and name behavioral differences that can change results. Begin incrementally from docs/START_HERE.md, docs/EYESIM_CAPABILITIES.md and the measured repetition divergence; unsupported methods remain explicitly marked gaps. Writing and reviewing current guidance must not wait for full baseline implementation. Completion still requires coverage of every required baseline entry point and honest result-changing conventions; removing the sequencing dependency does not waive completeness.
